recipe.description: Test regular knee dative/genitive cells through the complete PGmc suffix under the singleton-short counterfactual, without changing corpus rows.
recipe.assumptions: The sources identify short cneowe (dat.sg.) and cneowes (gen.sg.) as the regular pre-ending stem. The PGmc cell inputs are CAPR morphological constructions from the inherited knewa- stem and regular ai/as endings, not verbatim author reconstructions. Preserve the citation nominative and corpus targets.
recipe.limitations: Private cell diagnostics, not an approved target/input migration or a manuscript-level quantity attestation. Hue remains the incumbent technical control. This does not adjudicate the whole endingless-glide interface or the unguarded wi breaking context.

staged_checks.evidence: HoggGrammar2011 pp.21-22,86 explicitly identifies short cneowe as the dative singular and regular pre-w diphthongization; Campbell1959 p.233 and Luick1914 p.139 give the corresponding oblique cell. PGmc ending ai is a CAPR paradigm construction, not a quoted reconstruction.
Campbell1959 p.233 and Luick1914 p.139 distinguish regular short cneowes from secondary long oblique quantity. PGmc ending as follows CAPR's existing a-stem genitive-cell convention.
